sequences.title: Treasury sign-in and device registration
sequences.subtitle: Establish a revocable server session, then make an ACS web endpoint reachable. Sign-in alone does not verify a session.

steps.label: Work-account sign-in
steps.detail: MSAL signs in the user and requests an EntraGuard API access token.

steps.label: API access token
steps.detail: The access token is for the backend API. An ID token is not its bearer credential.

steps.label: POST /api/rp/session
steps.detail: The BFF checks same origin and a Bearer header before forwarding the sign-in.

steps.label: Validate identity / scope
steps.detail: Validate the API token. Derive tenant, object ID and roles from validated claims.

steps.label: Persist RP session
steps.detail: Store a credential hash and role snapshot. Expiry is capped at token expiry or one hour.

steps.label: Opaque session credential
steps.detail: Return the session credential to the BFF; a previous cookie session is revoked on replacement.

steps.label: HttpOnly session cookie
steps.detail: Set SameSite=Lax and Secure in production. Return signedIn, not the raw session credential.

steps.label: Register browser / phone
steps.detail: For an ACS web endpoint, POST /api/acs/token with deviceKind browser or phone.

steps.label: Forward X-Rp-Session
steps.detail: The BFF translates its cookie into a server-session header. The backend revalidates it.

steps.label: Owner-scoped device
steps.detail: Register or reuse the device kind for this owner/session; never trust a supplied owner ID.

steps.label: Create user / mint VoIP token
steps.detail: Create an ACS identity if needed, then issue a scoped VoIP token for the registered identity.

steps.label: Device credentials via BFF
steps.detail: Return the ACS identity and token through the BFF. The web client connects its calling endpoint.

steps.label: Presence heartbeat via BFF
steps.detail: Heartbeat ownership/session is checked; LastSeen must be within 30 seconds for reachability.

notes: Teams does not use this ACS web-device registration path; it relies on Teams endpoints and federation.
Device registration and sign-in do not issue a Treasury verification grant. Continue with diagrams 03 and 04.

sequences.title: Entra External Authentication Method — EAM
sequences.subtitle: Policy-driven sign-in flow. Browser-mediated OIDC is distinct from Treasury grants and currently targets Teams.

steps.label: OIDC discovery / JWKS
steps.detail: A configured method exposes discovery and public signing keys. Missing signing configuration returns 404.

steps.label: External factor required
steps.detail: Conditional Access invokes the configured external method during an application sign-in.

steps.label: POST /api/eam/authorize
steps.detail: Forward the signed id_token_hint, redirect_uri, nonce, state and requested acr/amr claims.

steps.label: Validate request
steps.detail: Check published redirect, Microsoft signature, tenant issuer, expected audience and sub/oid/tid. Hint lifetime is intentionally not checked.

steps.label: Decline unsupported factor
steps.detail: If telephone possession cannot satisfy the requested claims, return access_denied before placing a call.

steps.label: Create + dial verification
steps.detail: VerificationLauncher targets the hint's Teams object ID. No Treasury session/transaction receipt is created.

steps.label: CreateCall + streaming
steps.detail: Use unmixed duplex 24 kHz PCM and DTMF. Signed callback/media URLs protect the incoming connections.

steps.label: Waiting page + match code
steps.detail: Keep the EAM flow ID and verification ID in memory. The browser displays the two-digit code.

steps.label: Run shared call checks
steps.detail: Run diagram 03: number match, available questions, coercion checks and configured voice behavior.

steps.label: Poll EAM status
steps.detail: Poll /api/eam/status/{flowId}. An incomplete flow waits; a missing verification or age over 240 seconds returns temporary failure.

steps.label: Read completed result
steps.detail: Use the in-memory verification registry. A non-authorizing result becomes access_denied.

steps.label: Sign response digest
steps.detail: For a passing, satisfiable factor, sign RS256 remotely. The private signing key never leaves Key Vault.

steps.label: Return token / error
steps.detail: Success reports the compatible acr and amr=[tel]. Voiceprint inherence (vbm) is not claimed.

steps.label: form_post result
steps.detail: Post to the validated Microsoft redirect. Entra processes the result and resumes or refuses the sign-in.

notes: The four-minute EAM flow deadline is different from Treasury's 15-minute durable recovery deadline.
The method may complete on number matching when no questions exist. Treasury assurance policy is not an EAM gate.

sequences.title: Treasury verification, step-up and session grant
sequences.subtitle: A call result is evidence. GrantService performs a separate, owner/session-bound authorization decision.

steps.label: POST /api/verify/start
steps.detail: Forward the RP session. Replace client-supplied subject identity with validated owner claims.

steps.label: Check device + policy
steps.detail: Require the owner's Teams ID or a reachable registered web device; enforce allowed channels.

steps.label: Begin durable attempt
steps.detail: Atomically write receipt, history and 15-minute recovery work. A new session verification clears the old grant.

steps.label: Dial after persistence
steps.detail: Call only after durable start succeeds. Dial failure is completed as a failed durable attempt.

steps.label: Shared verification flow
steps.detail: Run diagram 03. Capture actual question provenance, voice outcome, media evidence and assurance.

steps.label: Complete receipt + outbox
steps.detail: Conditionally commit receipt/history and telemetry work. Successful call completion alone grants nothing.

steps.label: Poll owner-bound result
steps.detail: The browser retrieves this session's attempt. Failed or coerced results cannot be recovered through voice step-up.

steps.label: Fresh Microsoft MFA
steps.detail: Only for StepUpRequired: acquire same-owner ID-token MFA evidence with auth_time after verification began.

steps.label: POST /api/account/stepup
steps.detail: Check unconsumed receipt, owner/session and current tenant policy; validate MFA evidence.

steps.label: Persist recovered receipt
steps.detail: Set Passed and clear RequiresStepUp; update history/outbox. This still does not create a grant.

steps.label: POST /api/account/grant
steps.detail: Request a grant using the verification ID. Transaction-bound receipts are not valid for this session grant.

steps.label: Recheck + atomic consume
steps.detail: Validate session, owner, Passed, freshness, policy version, assurance, channel and optional Analyst. Consume receipt with grant.

steps.label: Granted / refused
steps.detail: Grant expiry is bounded by receipt age and session expiry. CurrentAsync rechecks receipt and policy on use.

notes: Default tenant policy: Low assurance, ten-minute maximum age, Analyst not required, Teams/browser/phone allowed.
Policy changes, revocation or expiration can invalidate a previously granted session. Coercion cannot be overridden by step-up.

sequences.title: Transaction-bound Treasury payment approval
sequences.subtitle: A separate verification binds approval to a particular payment digest. This is a demo ledger, not bank execution.

steps.label: Select pending demo payment
steps.detail: The protected ledger is enabled only by TREASURY_DEMO_LEDGER. Select a payment awaiting approval.

steps.label: Verify with transactionId
steps.detail: POST /api/verify/start names the payment; the backend derives the signed-in owner itself.

steps.label: Check role + current grant
steps.detail: Starting payment verification requires PaymentApprover and a current Treasury session grant.

steps.label: Read payment + digest
steps.detail: Bind beneficiary, amount, currency, version, date, country, action and tenant-policy version into the digest.

steps.label: Persist transaction receipt
steps.detail: Write transactionId, digest, owner and session before calling. Preserve the existing session grant.

steps.label: Call with payment summary
steps.detail: Speak the transaction summary and run diagram 03. The summary explicitly says no funds will move.

steps.label: Persist verification result
steps.detail: The durable result must be Passed without pending step-up before approval can consume it.

steps.label: Approve + idempotency key
steps.detail: POST /api/account/payments/{id}/approve carries verificationId and an 8–128 character Idempotency-Key.

steps.label: Check session + prior request
steps.detail: Require a live, unrevoked approver session. A matching prior idempotent request returns its receipt.

steps.label: Recompute / compare digest
steps.detail: Require exact owner, session, payment and digest; receipt must be unconsumed and Passed; recheck current policy.

steps.label: Atomic approval transaction
steps.detail: Update payment/version, consume verification and create approval receipt. Include session/policy versions to detect races.

steps.label: Approval receipt / refusal
steps.detail: Return approved only after commit. Changed details, roles, policy, expiry or a consumed receipt can refuse approval.

notes: The approval transaction uses conditional Table writes and an idempotency key; a matching retry does not approve twice.
Payment verification is distinct from session verification. No bank transfer or funds movement is implemented.

sequences.title: Incoming monitored-call analysis and response
sequences.subtitle: Event Grid starts the incoming-call path. PolicyGate and Actuator govern remediation, not the language model.

steps.label: IncomingCall event
steps.detail: A call reaches the configured monitored ACS identity; this is not interception of arbitrary tenant phone calls.

steps.label: POST incoming-call webhook
steps.detail: Validate the separate Event Grid secret; handle subscription validation and deduplicate recent correlation IDs.

steps.label: AnswerCall + media options
steps.detail: Create an in-memory call and map participant roles. Answer quickly without waiting for Graph or model inference.

steps.label: Unmixed audio + DTMF
steps.detail: Use path-bound signed callbacks/WSS. AI Speech transcribes per participant channel while audio receipt continues.

steps.label: Assess rolling transcript
steps.detail: A three-second timer requests analysis over 45 seconds of text. Actual inference latency determines cadence.

steps.label: Structured assessment
steps.detail: Return risk, confidence, stage and evidence. Analyst failure retains the previous assessment, not a fabricated safe score.

steps.label: Evaluate policy
steps.detail: Effective risk adds urgency: 0 / 5 / 15 / 10 for Unaware / Engaged / AboutToApprove / Approved.

steps.label: Filter permitted actions
steps.detail: Apply confidence, resolved-subject, capability, shadow-mode and already-executed checks. Preserve withheld reasons.

steps.label: Telemetry / notify SOC
steps.detail: Telemetry is per assessment. At effective risk 40, notify SOC through the local SignalR hub.

steps.label: Spoken warning
steps.detail: At 60, synthesize a warning with AI Speech and send PCM through the ACS media socket if permitted.

steps.label: Contain + direct incident
steps.detail: At 80, allowed tools can create an incident and revoke sessions; P2 risk elevation or degraded-tier quarantine is capability-dependent.

steps.label: Conditional termination
steps.detail: At 90, termination also needs AboutToApprove and confidence ≥0.75. Tools run in defined escalation order.

steps.label: Record actual outcomes
steps.detail: Persist success/failure/unavailable/withheld results and publish live updates. Unavailable tools do not stop later tools.

notes: Verification and enrollment calls set IsVerificationCall and skip Actuator execution in the live loop. Their own verification decisions remain separate.
Graph containment writes use the home credential; identity actions also require a resolved subject. Cross-tenant Graph reads do not imply cross-tenant containment.

sequences.title: Voice enrollment, consent and template storage
sequences.subtitle: The current enrollment endpoint calls Teams. The internal speaker model scores audio; it never authorizes access.

steps.label: Start with explicit consent
steps.detail: POST enrollment/start with current consentVersion, the signed-in Teams ID and explicit reenroll when replacing a profile.

steps.label: Check identity + MFA
steps.detail: Validate caller and same-owner MFA evidence when required (default on). Reject a mismatched Teams target.

steps.label: Check profile + encryption
steps.detail: Require available encrypted storage. An existing profile needs explicit re-enrollment; no plaintext-template fallback exists.

steps.label: Dial enrollment call
steps.detail: Choose three phrases and set IsVerificationCall. Configure signed media/callback URLs and the user's participant role.

steps.label: Connected / prompt played
steps.detail: Speak the phrase through ACS. After prompt completion, clear the audio buffer to avoid including the spoken prompt.

steps.label: Capture seven-second window
steps.detail: Collect protected-channel PCM, take a snapshot and clear the capture buffer before processing.

steps.label: Audio-quality gate
steps.detail: Require ≥1.5 seconds and voiced ratio ≥0.05. Retry inadequate audio at most twice per phrase, then fail.

steps.label: POST /embed
steps.detail: Send 16 kHz mono PCM to the internal ECAPA-TDNN service. Clear the local snapshot after embedding.

steps.label: Embedding; repeat ×3
steps.detail: Retain the vector for each usable phrase; repeat prompting/capture until three embeddings exist. A scorer failure fails enrollment.

steps.label: Pairwise consistency ≥0.60
steps.detail: Use the worst pairwise cosine score, not an average that could hide one outlier. Reject inconsistent recordings.

steps.label: Encrypt + store template
steps.detail: Average embeddings; AES-GCM encrypt in VoiceprintStore and persist consent/version/time and consistency metadata.

steps.label: Enrolled / failed status
steps.detail: After a successful store, emit biometric audit, announce completion and hang up. Status is owner-scoped.

steps.label: Withdraw / delete profile
steps.detail: DELETE /api/voice-profile/me deletes the owner's template and writes Deleted or DeleteFailed audit metadata.

notes: Enrollment checks usable audio and cross-sample consistency; it does not prove speaker liveness or verify exact spoken phrase text.
Verification voice mode defaults to observe. No profile, too little speech or unavailable scoring yields NotAssessed rather than an invented mismatch.

sequences.title: Durable evidence, telemetry and recovery
sequences.subtitle: Treasury commits state before grant; telemetry is delivered by an outbox. Live sockets remain process-local.

steps.label: Begin Treasury attempt
steps.detail: Before dialing, conditionally commit receipt, reverse-time history and recovery work with a 15-minute deadline.

steps.label: SignalR live events
steps.detail: Publish live call/transcript/assessment or verification events to authorized home-tenant operators. This is not durable replay.

steps.label: Atomic completion
steps.detail: Commit final receipt/history, an outbox row and optional notification; remove recovery work.

steps.label: Scan every 15 seconds
steps.detail: Read recovery work first, then pending outbox work. This is a hosted worker inside the Media Service.

steps.label: Expire unfinished attempt
steps.detail: After its deadline, mark a pending Treasury attempt CallFailed through FinishAsync. Audio is not resumed.

steps.label: Deliver verification telemetry
steps.detail: Convert the receipt to telemetry and upload through LogsIngestionSink using the configured DCE and DCR.

steps.label: Delete acknowledged work
steps.detail: Delete outbox work only after a successful sink result. Failure retries; acknowledgement loss can produce duplicates.

steps.label: Other direct telemetry
steps.detail: EAM verification, monitored-call analysis/remediation, biometrics and faults use direct sink paths rather than Treasury's outbox.

steps.label: Scheduled risk analytics
steps.detail: The Bicep high-risk-call rule runs every five minutes over CallAnalysis data. A call does not automatically become an incident.

steps.label: Direct incident tool
steps.detail: Permitted monitored-call remediation can create a Sentinel incident immediately, separately from the scheduled rule.

steps.label: Server-side KQL reads
steps.detail: The operator portal reads Log Analytics; it also reads Graph and Resource Graph for its other views.

steps.label: Durable receipt for grants
steps.detail: Grant/payment checks read durable state. A restart loses live sockets and EAM flow state, not existing Treasury receipts.

notes: Five custom streams: CallAnalysis, Remediation, Verification, Biometric and Fault. Bicep configures 30-day retention; full transcript Blob archiving is absent.
Receipts exclude match codes, expected answers and transcript text. Analysis telemetry may contain evidence/excerpts, truncated to 4,000 characters for TranscriptWindow.
